difficulty_note: Reported difficulty, roughly 4 out of 10 — long rather than hard.
notes: No online trophies, no difficulty trophies, and no mission-medal trophies.
Save manually at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
The only missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude (#28); meditate at Lucia's balcony before Chapter 1 ends.

phases.advice: Play the story through. Make a manual save at the start of every chapter, meditate at Lucia's balcony before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a save from just before the finale.
phases.title: Story + save every chapter

phases.advice: Finish any 8 stranger strands for the silver, try each activity type once, and mop up the side-objective challenges as you go.
phases.title: Strangers, side missions, activities

phases.advice: Work district by district: cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, and every named district of Leonida. Keep meditating at each spot you find.
phases.title: Collectibles + whole map

phases.advice: Plan every escape before you go in. Launder marked bills as you earn them, and save up — the garage properties are expensive.
phases.title: Crime + money

phases.advice: Counters first, then the shooting-range golds, then the last races. Finish the 100% checklist and the platinum pops with A Long Road.
phases.title: Grind + cleanup

title: Roadmap to Platinum
